arabic text: PATA CHALE NA YE MAA KO, TARAP RAHA HAI HUSAIN
english translation text: THIS MOTHER SHOULD NOT FIND OUT THAT HUSSAIN’S CORPSE IS RESTLESS

arabic text: SALAAM USPE JO THERA ZAMEEN PE TEERON KI,\nWOH JISNE SAJDA E HAQ ME LAHOON JABEEN RAKHI
english translation text: PEACE ON HIM WHOSE BODY WAS ON ARROWS\nHE, WHO PLACED A BLOODIED FOREHEAD IN RIGHTEOUS PROSTRATION

arabic text: THA DASTO PAAKI YE SAAKIN KE CHAL RAHI THI CHURI\nWHO SAANS ROKE HUWE THA KE MAA TARHANE THI
english translation text: HIS HOLY HANDS WERE STILL AS THE DAGGER SLASHED (ACROSS HIS NECK)\nHE CEASED BREATHING AS HIS MOTHER WAS BY HIS HEADSIDE

arabic text: BOHOT SUKOON SE KHUDA KI TARAF CHALA HAI HUSSAIN
english translation text: WITH EASE, HUSSAIN HAS RETURNED TO HIS LORD

arabic text: JO MERA FARZ THA AMMA ADAA KIYA MAI NE\nZAMEEN MAIN LASHA E ASGHAR CHUPA DIYA MAI NE
english translation text: O MOTHER, I HAVE FULFILLED MY RESPONSIBILITY\nI HID THE DEAD BODY OF MY ASGHAR

arabic text: JAWAAN BETE KA LAASHA UTHA LIYE MAI NE\nME ABHI BHI PYAASA HOON PAANI NAHI PIYA MENE
english translation text: I PICKED UP THE BODY OF MY YOUNG SON\nI AM STILL THIRSTY, I HAVENT DRANK WATER YET

arabic text: GHAMOON SE BHAYI KE TOOTI HUI HAI MERI KAMAR\nJIGAR SE AKBAR-E-MEHROO KE KATRA HAI JIGAR
english translation text: GRIEF HAS BROKEN MY BACK\nMY CHEST IS BLEEDING FOR MY AKBAR

arabic text: KHUDA KA SHUKR ADA KAR RAHA HUN LAASHON PER\nNA ROYE AAP BOHT MUTMAIN HOON MAI MAADAR
english translation text: I AM BEING THANKFUL TO MY LORD DESPITE LOSING MY BELOVED\nPLEASE DON’T CRY O MOTHER, I AM PLEASED

arabic text: MERI HI GODH MEI BACHA HUWA MERA BEJAAN\nJIGAR SE APNE JAWAAN KE NIKALI MENE SINA
english translation text: IN MY LAPS, MY SON TOOK HIS LAST BREATH\nFROM HIS CHEST I PULLED THE SPEAR

arabic text: GALE PE SHIMR JO KHANJAR YE HO RAHA HAI RAAVAAN\nBAS AKHRI YE MERA IMTEHAAN HAI AMMA
english translation text: THIS DAGGER THAT SHIMR IS CUTTING MY NECK WITH\nTHIS IS MY FINAL TEST, O MOTHER

arabic text: ZAMEEN YE AA NA SAKI RAAS KOI BAAT NAHI\nNAHI MADAD KO KOI PAAS KOI BAAT NAHI
english translation text: THIS LAND WAS NOT FOR ME, BUT ITS FINE\nTHERE IS NO ONE TO HELP ME, BUT ITS FINE

arabic text: HUWI NA KHATAM MERI PYAAS KOI BAAT NAHI\nKHUDA KO DEDIYA ABBAS KOI BAAT NAHI
english translation text: MY THIRST HASN’T BEEN QUENCHED, BUT ITS FINE\nI GAVE MY ABBAS TO MY LORD, BUT ITS FINE.
